source_book: Survey Curious? Start-Up Guide — Bergman, Chinco, Hartzmark, Sussman (2020)

test_cases.prompt: I have a survey draft. Should I run a pilot before full launch?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate pilot-protocol. Two-stage field test: pretest with 1-2 non-economist friends; pilot with 50-100 real participants before full 500 launch. Don't analyze pilot data on the target hypothesis; only check instrument.
test_cases.notes: Direct 'should I run a pilot' signal.

test_cases.prompt: I just got my pilot data back with 80 respondents. Can I now ship the rest?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate pilot-protocol. Walk through the pilot-data inspection checklist: drop-out asymmetry, ceiling/floor, latency drops, right-most pileups, free-text response review. Decide if bugs are fixed before launching the remaining 400-450.

test_cases.prompt: I keep finding bugs in my survey after I launch — last time I had to scrap 200 responses because of a broken skip. How do I prevent this?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate pilot-protocol. Default: this would have been caught by a 50-respondent pilot before full launch. Recommend two-stage test discipline going forward.

test_cases.prompt: Free-text 'what was confusing?' responses from my pilot — what am I looking for?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate pilot-protocol. Free-text is the canonical bug-discovery channel. Read every response. Categorize: wording, UI, instructions, condition-imbalance, treatment-subtlety. Then fix or launch.

test_cases.prompt: Should I add 5 more items to my survey to make it more reliable?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate pilot-protocol. This is an item-design question (add convergence evidence). Defer to converging-evidence-design.
test_cases.notes: Trap: 'items' adj to 'pilot'; this is design-stage, not pilot-stage.

test_cases.prompt: Should I run my survey on MTurk or Prolific?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate pilot-protocol. Platform selection is upstream. Defer to platform-selection.
test_cases.notes: Trap: 'run my survey' is the pilot verb; but platform choice comes first.

test_cases.prompt: My treatment arm has 30% drop-out, my control has 8%. Is this a problem?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate pilot-protocol. This is post-launch attrition diagnosis. Defer to selective-attrition-audit.
test_cases.notes: Trap: 'my survey has a problem' sounds like pilot; but the issue is asymmetric attrition, not instrument bugs.

test_cases.prompt: I have 50 pilot responses. Can I analyze them to see if my hypothesis holds before launching the rest?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Edge: NO. Explicitly forbid hypothesis-testing on pilot. Recommend pre-registered cleaning rules and instrument-only inspection at pilot stage. Acknowledge the temptation; explain why it's a discipline that needs defending.
test_cases.notes: Edge: the canonical anti-pattern. Hold the line.

notes: Trap: 'my survey has a problem' is too vague — could mean design, pilot, attrition, or interpretation. Filter by timeline: if before full launch = pilot-protocol; if after full launch = selective-attrition-audit or relative-vs-absolute.
